description_en: Queries the details of Asset Fingerprints for startup items, kernel modules, or web sites
description_zh: 查询资产指纹启动项、内核模块或者Web站点详情列表
name: GetAssetsPropertyDetail

parameters.help_en:
The language type of the request and response messages. Valid values:
zh: Chinese
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：
zh：中文
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The type of Asset Fingerprints to query. Default value: sca. Valid values:

lkm: kernel module
autorun: startup item
web_server: web site
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的资产指纹的类型，默认值为sca。取值：

lkm：内核模块
autorun：启动项
web_server：Web站点
parameters.name: biz

parameters.help_en:
The aggregation item name of the Asset Fingerprints to query.
Call the [GetAssetsPropertyItem](~~GetAssetsPropertyItem~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的资产指纹的聚合项名称。
调用[GetAssetsPropertyItem](~~GetAssetsPropertyItem~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: item_name

fields.help_en:
The name of the search criterion. Valid values:
remarkItemName: the aggregation item name of Asset Fingerprints. Fuzzy match is supported.


- When Biz is set to web_server, remarkItemName indicates the domain name.
- When Biz is set to lkm, remarkItemName indicates the module name.
- When Biz is set to autorun, remarkItemName indicates the startup item path
fields.help_zh:
指定要查询的条件名称。取值如下：
remarkItemName：资产指纹聚合项名称，支持模糊匹配


- Biz取值为web_server时，remarkItemName表示搜索条件为域名。
- Biz取值为lkm时，remarkItemName表示搜索条件为模块名称。
- Biz取值为autorun时，remarkItemName表示搜索条件为自启动项路径
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The value of the search criterion
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The collection of search criteria for querying Asset Fingerprints details
parameters.help_zh: 指定要资产指纹详情查询的条件集合
parameters.name: search_criteria_list

parameters.help_en: The server name or IP address
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the asset to query.
Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的资产的UUID。
调用[DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~)接口获取该参数
parameters.name: uuid

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为1，表示从第1页开始显示
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paging query. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned per page by default.
Do not leave PageSize empty
parameters.help_zh:
指定分页查询时，每页显示的数据最大条数。每页默认显示的数据条数为20条，PageSize参数值为空时，将默认返回20条数据。
建议PageSize取值不要为空
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the NextToken method to retrieve the vulnerability list. If this parameter is used, TotalCount is no longer returned. Valid values:

true: Use the NextToken method.
false: Do not use the NextToken method
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用NextToken方式拉取漏洞列表数据。如果使用此参数TotalCount不再返回。取值：

true：使用NextToken方式。
false：不使用NextToken方式
parameters.name: use_next_token

parameters.help_en:
The token that marks the starting position for the query. Leave this parameter empty to query from the beginning.

Do not specify this parameter for the first call. The response includes the NextToken value for the next call. Each subsequent response contains the NextToken value for the following call
parameters.help_zh:
用来标记当前开始读取的位置，置空表示从头开始。

第一次调用不用填写，会在返回结果中包含第二次调用时用的NextToken，之后每次调用返回结果中都有下一次调用时的NextToken
parameters.name: next_token

PageInfo.description_en: The paging information displayed on the page
PageInfo.description_zh: 分页查询时页面显示的信息

Count.description_en: The number of Asset Fingerprints detail entries on the current page
Count.description_zh: 当前页面显示的资产指纹详情信息的数量

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the current page in a paging query
CurrentPage.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

NextToken.description_en: The NextToken value returned when the NextToken method is used

PageSize.description_en: The number of Asset Fingerprints details displayed per page in a paging query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的资产指纹详情信息的数量

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of Asset Fingerprints detail entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的资产指纹详情信息的总数量

Propertys.description_en: The collection of Asset Fingerprints details

Agent.example: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0%3B Win64%3B x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/125.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/125.0.0.0

CreateTimestamp.description_en: The timestamp of the latest Asset Fingerprints scan, in milliseconds
CreateTimestamp.description_zh: 资产指纹最新扫描时间戳，单位毫秒

The domain name of the web site.
This parameter is returned only when Biz is set to web_server
Domain.description_zh:
Web站点域名。
仅Biz取值为web_server时返回

EndPoint.description_en: The endpoint address of the large language model service
EndPoint.description_zh: 大模型服务请求接口地址

File.description_en: The file path for requesting the large language model service
File.description_zh: 请求大模型服务的文件路径

Filepath.description_en:
The file path of the kernel module.
This parameter is returned only when Biz is set to lkm
Filepath.description_zh:
内核模块文件路径。
仅Biz取值为lkm时返回

InstallationPath.description_en: The installation path of the AI tool

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the server

InstanceName.description_en: The name of the server instance

InternetIp.description_en: The public IP address of the server

IntranetIp.description_en: The private IP address of the server

Ip.description_en: The IP address of the server

ListenProtocol.description_en:
The listening protocol of the web site process.
This parameter is returned only when Biz is set to web_server

Web站点进程监听协议。

MiddlewareName.description_en: The name of the AI tool

MiddlewareVersion.description_en: The version of the AI tool

ModelName.description_en: The name of the large language model provider

The module name.
This parameter is returned only when Biz is set to lkm
ModuleName.description_zh:
模块名称。
仅Biz取值为lkm时返回

Path.description_en:
The meaning of this parameter varies based on the value of Biz:
When Biz is set to web_server, this parameter indicates the web root path.
When Biz is set to autorun, this parameter indicates the startup item path
Path.description_zh:
根据Biz取值不同表示不同含义：
Biz取值为web_server时，表示Web根路径
Biz取值为autorun时，表示启动项路径
Path.title_en: 启动项:路径 web站点:安装路径
Path.title_zh: 启动项:路径 web站点:安装路径

PathMode.description_en:
The directory permissions of the web site.
This parameter is returned only when Biz is set to web_server
PathMode.description_zh:
Web站点目录权限。
仅Biz取值为web_server时返回

Pid.description_en:
The PID of the web site process.
This parameter is returned only when Biz is set to web_server

Web站点进程Pid。
仅Biz取值为web_server时返回

Port.description_en:
The port of the web site.

Port.description_zh:
Web站点端口。
仅Biz取值为web_server时返回

ProcessStarted.description_en:
The timestamp when the web site process started, in milliseconds.
This parameter is returned only when Biz is set to web_server
ProcessStarted.description_zh:
Web站点进程启动时间戳，单位为毫秒。
仅Biz取值为web_server时返回

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the instance

RepoNamespace.description_en: The repo namespace of the image

ServerType.description_en:
The type of the web site.
This parameter is returned only when Biz is set to web_server
ServerType.description_zh:
Web站点类型。
仅Biz取值为web_server时返回

Size.description_en:
The size of the kernel module.
This parameter is returned only when Biz is set to lkm
Size.description_zh:
内核模块大小。
仅Biz取值为lkm时返回

UsedByCount.description_en:
The number of dependencies on the kernel module.
This parameter is returned only when Biz is set to lkm
UsedByCount.description_zh:
内核模块被依赖数目。
仅Biz取值为lkm时返回

User.description_en:
The user of the web site.
This parameter is returned only when Biz is set to web_server
User.description_zh:
Web站点用户。
仅Biz取值为web_server时返回

WebPath.description_en:
The web path of the web site.
This parameter is returned only when Biz is set to web_server
WebPath.description_zh:
Web站点Web路径。
仅Biz取值为web_server时返回

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
